# Copilot repository guidance

This repository is an agentic digital garden: a .NET application suite for personal knowledge, coaching, and agent-assisted workflows.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the authoritative repository conventions, build/test commands, configuration, messaging, and code style. Read [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) and relevant decision records before architectural changes; keep implementation status and acceptance evidence current in the roadmap.

Reusable .NET skills, assistant agents, plugins, and machine-specific language-server settings are user tooling. Do not vendor them here. See [personal tooling](../docs/runbooks/personal-tooling.md) for the boundary and global setup.
